integrity: The proof explicitly uses the global convergence theorem of Baigent et al. (2023). The derived logarithmic contraction, exponentially accurate scalar reduction, inverse-shadowing, and critical asymptotic calculations are analytical. Symbolic and numerical checks supplement but do not replace the proof. Unindexed equivalent results remain an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Fixed unequal weak competition 0<alpha,beta<1, both intrinsic growth parameters exactly 2 and both initial species strictly positive; no exact description of all exponentially converging states, no uniformity at parameter boundaries, and no extension to arbitrary competition strength or unequal growth.
title: Asymmetric critical synchronization and logarithmic relaxation in planar Ricker competition
